The change is correct and necessary. NetworksHandler.read -> NetworksListingForm.filter_subnets orders subnets by id (`subnets.order_by("id")`, forms/__init__.py:2272), and network names are `"subnet-%d" % subnet.id` (networks.py:23-25). Lexicographically sorting those name strings (the previous assertion) diverges from the server's numeric id ordering once ids span a power-of-ten boundary (e.g. subnet-100 < subnet-99). Sorting the subnets by `subnet.id` before mapping to names correctly mirrors `order_by("id")`. Minor pre-existing nit: the test name `test_GET_sorts_by_name` is now slightly inaccurate since it verifies id ordering rather than name ordering, but that is outside this diff's scope.
